tr_drawer_close_desk_purchase_cash_drawe: Desk purchases paid from cash drawer
tr_drawer_close_vendor_cash_drawer: Supplier payments from cash drawer (deposit / pay)

tr_purchase_treasury_method_hint: Where this intake cost was paid from (configured under Store Settings).
